info.name: Fundraise Up REST Donations Events API

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records to return, from 1 to 100.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: A cursor (object ID) to fetch the page of records after it.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: A cursor (object ID) to fetch the page of records before it.

items.docs: Retrieves audit-log events across donations, transaction attempts, recurring plans, tributes, and supporters, with cursor-based pagination.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of a specific event by ID.
